spec:dynamic-choice.spec: After M0: two independent nondeterministic booleans select promoted versus local &[MU<u8>;3] for left/right. Use full/full positive and separate left/right hole negatives; keep same compare specialization. No assume initializedness.

spec:coalesced-offset.spec: After M0: borrow equal full promoted [MU<u8>;6] referents; compare in-bounds &[MU<u8>;3] views at offsets 0/3 via raw casts, then distinct mask-hole variants on left/right. Positive byte values 7; separate negatives with None inside selected view. Never assume distinct addresses or derive ownership from address equality.

spec:slice-offset-pair.spec: After M0: [MU<u8>;5] -> &mut [MU<u8>] subrange 1..4; copy two slots from source offset 1 to destination offset 2 in distinct arrays. Positive scalar 7/7; independent negative source hole in each copied position with initialized non-read companion. Verify outside sentinels unchanged; no array equality.

spec:ordinary-normal-return.spec: After D0-A/M0: noinline fn produce()->[u8;3] returning [7;3], caller stores normal destination then performs scalar reads and retained raw_eq against full promoted reference. Distinct abnormal-edge spec must not bless destination on unwind/abort.

spec:abnormal-return.spec: After M0: actual reachable ordinary call with normal and abnormal MIR successors under supported panic strategy; normal destination is initialized only on normal successor. Assert no after-return setter or LoadArgument(return0) on unwind/abort. If panic=abort removes unwind, keep unwind UNKNOWN rather than fabricate an edge.

spec:zst-protocol.spec: After M0: noinline sized MU<()> and [MU<()>;3] copy/reset/by-value argument/return plus [MU<u8>;0]. Scalar sentinel after ZST operation; retain argument/count/return0 pairing even when byte extent=0. Pair with nonempty hole; no arbitrary-union ZST-arm claim.

spec:legal-pfc.spec: After M0: reuse no-contract select/relay MU<u16> scalar roundtrip; legal PFC variant with modifies(out), writes only *out=relay(new(7)).assume_init(), ensures scalar 7. Compare identical flags/base/candidate; generated DFCC roots and private shadow effects must be bound. Do not duplicate old negative bodies.

spec:root-order.spec: After D0-A/M0: run same legal/hole compare specialization roots separately and jointly AB/BA, exact same MIR inputs/options. Also preserve D0 AB/BA jobs without editing its two harnesses. Compare per-root JSON properties and transformed body/cache identity.
